payload.name: Preserve explicit current-focus statements during extraction
payload.description: When extracting or updating memories from a message, if the speaker explicitly states what they are focusing on, prioritizing, or working on lately, preserve that claim itself and do not replace it with only the supporting activities.
content: During extraction, identify explicit statements of current focus, priorities, or recent emphasis (phrases like 'I've been focusing on', 'I'm prioritizing', 'lately I've been working on').
Create a memory or enrich the relevant existing memory with the explicit focus claim itself, not only the associated activities or examples.
When the same message also mentions supporting activities, include both the explicit focus claim and the activities so the memory answers questions about focus directly.

solves: Future questions ask what someone has been focusing on lately. The extraction lost the explicit focus statement and kept only supporting activities, so memory could not answer. Reusable rule: preserve explicit focus/priority claims as primary evidence when extracting, not just examples. Applies when a message states an explicit focus with supporting activities; not when only activities appear.
